class G {
public:
    G() {
        submit();

private:
    void submit() {

        int k = nextInt();
        int s = nextInt() - 1;
        long long t = nextLong();

    int solve(int n, int k, int s, long long t) {
        while (t % n != 0) {
            int delta = (s < k ? 1 : -1) * static_cast<int>(t % n);
            s = (s + n + delta) % n;
            t--;
        }

        t /= n;

        std::vector<long long> when(n, -1);

        for (long long left = t; left > 0; left--) {
            if (when[s] != -1) {
                long long period = when[s] - left;

                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (when[i] != -1 && when[i] <= when[s] && when[i] % period == 0) {
                        return i;
                    }
                }

                throw std::runtime_error("Assertion error");
            }
            when[s] = left;

            for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                if (s < k) {
                    s += i;
                    if (s >= n) {
                        s -= n;
                    }
                } else {
                    s -= i;
                    if (s < 0) {
                        s += n;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return s;
    }

    int go(int n, int m) {
        std::vector<int> a(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = i;
        }
        for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int delta = a[j] < m ? 1 : -1;
                a[j] = (a[j] + n + i * delta) % n;
            }
        }

        return maxDepth(a);
    }

    int maxDepth(const std::vector<int>& p) {
        int n = p.size();
        std::vector<int> used(n, -1);
        int ret = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int cur = 0;
            int v = i;
            while (used[v] != i) {
                used[v] = i;
                cur++;
                v = p[v];
            }
            ret = std::max(ret, cur);
        }
        return ret;
    }

    void test() {
        for (int s = 0; s < 65536; s++) {
            std::cerr << solve(65536, 1, s, 1000000000000LL) << std::endl;
        }
    }

    void stress() {
        for (int tst = 0;; tst++) {
            if (false) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Assertion error");
            }
            std::cerr << tst << std::endl;
        }
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int ret = 0;
        int b = skip();
        if (b != '-' && (b < '0' || b > '9')) {
            throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        }
        bool neg = false;
        if (b == '-') {
            neg = true;
            b = readByte();
        }
        while (true) {
            if (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
                ret = ret * 10 + (b - '0');
            } else {
                if (b != -1 && !isTrash(b)) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
                }
                return neg ? -ret : ret;
            }
            b = readByte();
        }
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        long long ret = 0;
        int b = skip();
        if (b != '-' && (b < '0' || b > '9')) {
            throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        }
        bool neg = false;
        if (b == '-') {
            neg = true;
            b = readByte();
        }
        while (true) {
            if (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
                ret = ret * 10 + (b - '0');
            } else {
                if (b != -1 && !isTrash(b)) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
                }
                return neg ? -ret : ret;
            }
            b = readByte();
        }
    }

    int readByte() {
        if (bufSz == -1)
            throw std::runtime_error("Reading past EOF");
        if (bufPtr >= bufSz) {
            bufPtr = 0;
            bufSz = fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), stdin);
            if (bufSz <= 0)
                return -1;
        }
        return buf[bufPtr++];
    }

    bool isTrash(int c) {
        return c < 33 || c > 126;
    }

    int skip() {
        int b;
        while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && isTrash(b))
            ;
        return b;
    }

    std::string nextToken() {
        int b = skip();
        std::ostringstream sb;
        while (!isTrash(b)) {
            sb << static_cast<char>(b);
            b = readByte();
        }
        return sb.str();
    }

    std::string nextString() {
        int b = readByte();
        std::ostringstream sb;
        while (!isTrash(b) || b == ' ') {
            sb << static_cast<char>(b);
            b = readByte();
        }
        return sb.str();
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        return std::stod(nextToken());
    }

    char nextChar() {
        return static_cast<char>(skip());
    }

private:
    static std::mt19937 rng;
    static const int C = 5;

    static int rand(int l, int r) {
        std::uniform_int_distribution<int> dist(l, r);
        return dist(rng);
    }

    unsigned char buf[1 << 14];
    int bufSz = 0, bufPtr = 0;
};
